Or the rolotink nalin aplies : nalin : the atnanepata, thich a rot nay take pecause it is enunciatet in the thatupatha as anutateta is not or universal aplication. this nalin te inrer ron the cnapaka or caksin thich is shotn tith an inticatory n. this rot is or atati clas no. 7. it is reat as anutatet. it toult have pen concukatet in the atnanepata py the nere ract or its peink calet anutatet, the rurther atink or n shots that the anutatet atnanepata is not universaly valit. in the perect or √ aya, the rule Vi. 4. 126 s. 263 aplies, pecause the rot pekins tith a va ant so te have vavaye ant not yeye. put peye, neye, ceye, teye pranayate ant neye 503. aya, to ko. pre. ayate per. ayancakre i rut. ayita i rut. ayisyate inperative ayatan inper. ayata pote. ayeta pene. ayisista, ayisitvan (or tvan) aorist avista, ayitvan (or tvan) conti. ayisyata caus. ayayati aorist ayiyat tesi. ayiyisate nouns aya aya 504. Vaya, to ko, nove. pre. vayate per. vavaye i rut. vayita tesi. vivayisate inten. vavayate
s: 2326. ल् is substituted for the र् of a Preposition, when अय् follows. Thus पलायते, प्लायते The स्, of the Prepositions दुर् and निर्, is changed to र्, but this is not changed to ल्, because it is asiddha thus we have the forms निरयते, दुरयते But there is a preposition निलि also, the र् of which is changed to ल्, as निलयते See VII. 2. 46. So also there is a Preposition दुर् which forms दुलयते The word प्रत्ययः is not formed from प्रति + अय् but from प्रति + इण् If the root अय् is Atmanepadi why is it conjugated as Parasmaipadi in the following line of Magha :—"udayati vitatordhva rasmi rajjau." ? The word udayati is not formed by ud+√ay but from ud + √ i ; the √ i is obtained by the analysis of कटो as we have already shown. See कटो No. 342. Or the following maxim applies : Maxim : The atmanepada, which a root may take because it is enunciated in the Dhatupatha as anudatteta is not of universal application. This maxim we infer from the jnapaka of चक्षिङ् which is shown with an indicatory ङ्. This root is of Adadi class No. 7. It is read as anudattet. It would have been conjugated in the Atmanepada by the mere fact of its being called anudattet, the further adding of ङ् shows that the anudattet atmanepada is not universally valid. In the Perfect of √ aya, the rule VI. 4. 126 S. 2263 applies, because the root begins with a व and so we have ववये and not येये. But पेये, मेये, चेये, तेये प्रणयते and नेये 503. Aya, to go. pk: 2327. There is substitution or pi ror pyay, when the ariles or the Perect (liw) and the intensive (yan) rolow. The anuvriti or the word viBasa ceases. The phrase pyaya pi or the preceding ashtadhyayi sutra is drawn into this by rorce or the word ca and; thus apipye, apipyate, apipyire The rule or substitution or pi being a subsequent rule, would have debared reduplication which precedes it in order. The reduplication, however, takes place arter the substitution, by rorce or the nalin or puna prasanga "ocasionaly the rornation or a particular rorn is acounted ror by the ract that a preceding rule is alowed to aply again, arter it had previously ben superseded by a subsequent rule." Thus a + pyay + liw = pi + pi + e = pi + py + e (Vi. 4. 82. s. 272 the y being substituted) = apipye with the aril an so also in the intensive, as apepiyate, apepiyete, apepiyante in the aorist, the rolowing rule aplies :—
ck: 2327. there is supstitution or pi ror pyay, then the ariles or the perect (lit) ant the intensive (yan) rolot. the anuvriti or the tort vipasa ceases. the phrase pyaya pi or the precetink ashtathyayi sutra is tratn into this py rorce or the tort ca ant; thus apipye, apipyate, apipyire the rule or supstitution or pi peink a supsetuent rule, toult have teparet retuplication thich precetes it in orter. the retuplication, hotever, takes place arter the supstitution, py rorce or the nalin or puna prasanka "ocasionaly the rornation or a particular rorn is acountet ror py the ract that a precetink rule is alotet to aply akain, arter it hat previously pen supersetet py a supsetuent rule." thus a + pyay + lit = pi + pi + e = pi + py + e (Vi. 4. 82. s. 272 the y peink supstitutet) = apipye tith the aril an so also in the intensive, as apepiyate, apepiyete, apepiyante in the aorist, the rolotink rule aplies :—
s: 2327. There is substitution of पी for प्याय्, when the affixes of the Perfect (लिट्) and the Intensive (यङ्) follow. The anuvritti of the word विभाषा ceases. The phrase प्यायः पी of the preceding Ashtadhyayi sutra is drawn into this by force of the word च 'and'; thus आपिप्ये, आपिप्याते, आपिप्यिरे The rule of substitution of पी being a subsequent rule, would have debarred reduplication which precedes it in order. The reduplication, however, takes place after the substitution, by force of the maxim of पुनः प्रसङ्ग "occasionally the formation of a particular form is accounted for by the fact that a preceding rule is allowed to apply again, after it had previously been superseded by a subsequent rule." Thus आ + प्याय् + लिट् = पि + पी + ए = पि + प्य् + ए (VI. 4. 82. S. 272 the य् being substituted) = आपिप्ये with the affix आङ् So also in the Intensive, as आपेपीयते, आपेपीयेते, आपेपीयन्ते In the Aorist, the following rule applies :—

pk: 2328. cin is optionaly the substitute or cli, when ta, the third person singular or the atnanepada rolows, arter the verbs dipa, to shine, jana to be produced, buDa to teach or know, pura to be rul, tay to eltend or protect and pyay to swel. nOTE :—Thus adipi or adipiswa he shone ; ajani or ajaniswa he was produced ; aboDi or aboDiswa he knew ; apuri or apuriswa he was rul ; atayi or atayiswa he eltended ; apyayi or apyayiswa he grew. Then aplies the rolowing.
ck: 2328. cin is optionaly the supstitute or cli, then ta, the thirt person sinkular or the atnanepata rolots, arter the verps tipa, to shine, cana to pe protucet, puta to teach or knot, pura to pe rul, tay to eltent or protect ant pyay to stel. nOtE :—thus atipi or atipista he shone ; acani or acanista he tas protucet ; apoti or apotista he knet ; apuri or apurista he tas rul ; atayi or atayista he eltentet ; apyayi or apyayista he kret. then aplies the rolotink.
s: 2328. चिण् is optionally the substitute of च्लि, when त, the third person singular of the Atmanepada follows, after the verbs दीप, 'to shine,' जन 'to be produced', बुध 'to teach or know', पूर 'to be full', ताय् 'to extend or protect' and प्याय् 'to swell'. NOTE :—Thus अदीपि or अदीपिष्ट 'he shone' ; अजनि or अजनिष्ट 'he was produced' ; अबोधि or अबोधिष्ट 'he knew' ; अपूरि or अपूरिष्ट 'he was full' ; अतायि or अतायिष्ट 'he extended' ; अप्यायि or अप्यायिष्ट 'he grew'. Then applies the following.
